summary: Tested Release A blockers and Release B identity/onboarding, both backend and UI. The main agent's suites test_release_ab_identity.py and test_release_ab_onboarding.py pass 4/4. The first run failed with 'skipped_locked' only because test_estate_scale.py was running at the same time and held the operator onboarding lock; it passed once that run ended. Regression suites pass 65/65: release_a, sage_sicon_customer_import, sage_sicon_import_independent, sicon_onboarding_jun2026 and the 3 AFS shared-matching suites. The new HTTP suite test_release_ab_api_iter336.py passes 10/13; the 3 failures are real defects. It covers: Sage pull 403 for a tenant and 400 without a company (503 when Sage is not configured); link migration dry run, apply, audit event and idempotency; delegates (customer user 400, unknown permission 400, unknown user 404); permissions enforced per action for review, approve, commit, activation, confidential and admin-only; sage-internal 403 then 200; backfill dry run writes nothing; Review Centre shows 'Unscoped Sicon link' and 'Sicon record held for review'. UI checks with Playwright, logged in as master admin through a minted token plus the ga_session cookie: Staff Permissions tab works and the customer user gets the 400 message. Reconcile select on a possible_existing_customer row sends {link_org_id}, the row becomes 'Link to existing customer' and Approve is enabled. Onboarding Projects → Customer data tab shows steps worked out from real data. Import Centre → Complete Customer Estate embeds the afs-onb-* wizard with no cross-login loop. SiconOnboardingSync shows the amber partial badge, sicon-sync-missing, sicon-sync-retrieved and Confirm & import for a partial preview. 3 defects confirmed plus 1 HIGH integration mismatch (see action_items).

critical.issue: A sync can reassign an established link. The first sync that claims a different Pulse id correctly sets sync_status='conflict'. The next sync with that id then reassigns the link, because the guard only fires when existing.sync_status == 'linked'. A link flagged by set_status ('failed', 'ignored') has the same hole. Reproduced: link pa, then sync pz (conflict, still pa), then sync pz again (link now pz). Test: test_sync_never_reassigns_link_even_after_conflict.

critical.endpoint: Sage company identity: Import Centre vs Sicon onboarding
critical.issue: Sicon onboarding resolves customers with find_orgs_by_ref(code, 'PULSE FITNESS'), from SICON_SAGE_COMPANY uppercased, and the company must match exactly. The Import Centre Sage file upload input (ci-company-input in SageSiconImport.js) has maxLength={12} and is labelled 'only if you run more than one Sage company'. So 'PULSE FITNESS' (13 characters) cannot be typed there, and customers imported by file with a blank or short code are never found by Sicon onboarding. All of their equipment would be held as 'not a single Pulse customer'. The CRM Sage pull prompt defaults to 'Pulse Fitness', which differs again from file imports.

Customer data can be read across tenants. _require_pulse_or_master allows any user with is_service_desk. owner@isodemo.com is a customer-tenant owner with is_service_desk=true, and gets 200 listing every Pulse onboarding project and its estate progress. Test: test_tenant_service_desk_user_cannot_read_pulse_onboarding_projects.

minor.issue: When a needs_review link is later scoped, migration_status/migration_reason are not $unset. The link keeps showing in the Review Centre as 'Unscoped Sicon link' even though source_company is set. Test: test_scoped_link_leaves_review_centre.

Falls back to the platform integration config 'sicon' credentials.company_id even when that integration is disabled. In preview that value is test data, 'TEST_CO', left by another test, so every link and migration gets scoped to TEST_CO. When no company is found, writes use source_company='unscoped' but _find never reads 'unscoped'.

ensure_project_for_org runs only when provision_customer_org creates a new org. A manual customer reconciled by link_org_id gets no onboarding project. Backfill only picks orgs with onboarding_status=pending_activation, which manual orgs usually lack.
Uses the stored is_pulse_staff flag and does not re-check that the user is still in the operator or platform org. Moving a delegate to another org keeps their permissions.
Loads every open sicon_import_conflicts and needs_review link with no limit. This will be slow on a large estate.

ui_bugs.issue: maxLength=12 blocks 'PULSE FITNESS', the Sicon connection company (see the HIGH backend item).

Once a candidate is linked, the select disappears and the decision cannot be changed from the row. The provisioning summary 'Existing organisations' stays 0 after the row becomes 'Link to existing customer'.
The held_no_customer and changed_since_preview counts are not shown. 'To review' shows 0 while equipment is held.

issues: Uses the browser's native window.prompt for the Sage company. Use a shadcn Dialog with a Select of the known companies instead.
Error messages (e.g. 400 'Only Pulse Fitness staff…') appear in the same grey as success messages; they need error styling.
The delegate list has no edit or revoke action. To revoke, you have to re-enter the email and save with no permissions.
Delegated staff have API permissions but no UI entry point: the Onboarding hub is only mounted in MasterAdminPage.
The list shows 500 cards. 5,255 archived 'TEST…' projects left by test suites (and undo) bury the 14 real ones under the default 'All statuses' filter.
The detail header shows 0% while the Customer data tab shows 'Account imported: Done'. The two progress sources disagree.

action_items: sicon_links.upsert_link: when not reassign, treat ANY existing non-empty pulse_entity_id that differs as a conflict, whatever its sync_status (linked, conflict, failed and so on). Do not overwrite it.

Unify the Sage company identity. Allow at least 30 characters in ci-company-input, and default or pre-fill it to the configured SICON_SAGE_COMPANY. Better still, offer a Select of the known companies. Also reconsider exact matching of '' against 'PULSE FITNESS' in find_orgs_by_ref when it is called from Sicon onboarding.
Onboarding projects routes: restrict them to Pulse staff (operator or platform org, or delegated activation.view or imports.*), not any is_service_desk tenant user.
Migration apply: $unset migration_status/migration_reason when scoping a link.
connection_company: ignore a disabled platform integration and remove the TEST_CO test data from the integration config. Make _find read 'unscoped' keys too, or never write them.
Create the onboarding project when a manual customer is reconciled (link_org_id commit), or widen the backfill filter to cover it.
Tests: delete onboarding_projects and the TST jobs they create. 5,255 archived TEST projects and 139 analysed TST jobs are polluting the UI.
Low priority: show held_no_customer and changed_since_preview counts in SiconSyncCounts, style delegate errors, and replace window.prompt in CRMSettings.
critical_code_review_comments: sicon_links._key_for_write and the v2 unique index are not partial. Two legacy unscoped links with the same type and id (missing source_company counts as null) cannot coexist. That is fine now (0 legacy in DB), but the 'reuse legacy' path assumes it.
sicon_onboarding._Run.destination_org caches per run, and resolution compares the company exactly. See the company identity issue.

claim_ref: the logic is sound (waits RESERVATION_WAIT_STEPS*0.5s; a dead or rolled-back job is taken over atomically). RESERVATION_WAIT_STEPS is mutated as a module global in tests, which is risky if tests run in parallel.
crm_sage200.push_contacts_to_sage (customers-to-sage) has no Pulse admin check and writes to Sage (pre-existing).

success_rate.backend: 95% (79/82 incl. regression; 3 failures are real defects)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the targeted flows render and work; 3 low and 1 high UI issues

seed_data_creation: None kept. Temporary items were created and deleted by id: a TEST_staff user in the operator org, TST link and conflict docs, TEST_run_ui_336, the reconcile org and site, and a committed TST265AF customer (rolled back, project deleted). Two 'sicon_links_scoped' audit events (actor admin) remain from the migration apply tests; they are audit logs and had no effect on data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master admin has MFA enforced. For the UI, mint a token with tests.test_sage_sicon_customer_import._token(email), put it in localStorage 'token' AND set it as the ga_session cookie; some components use bare axios. Pages: /master-admin?section=onboarding&tab=delegates|projects|history|import-centre&type=estate|sage_accounts. Do not run test_estate_scale.py at the same time as test_release_ab_identity: both use the operator onboarding lock, giving skipped_locked. The Sicon mock at localhost:51080 is not running. The 3 failing tests in test_release_ab_api_iter336.py mark the defects to retest.
rca of the issue: Link reassignment: sicon_links.py line ~130 checks for conflicts only when existing.sync_status=='linked'. After the first conflict sets the status to 'conflict', the next upsert falls through to $set pulse_entity_id. Cross-tenant project read: _require_pulse_or_master treats is_service_desk as Pulse staff, but that flag is per tenant (iso-demo owner has it). Company mismatch: SICON_SAGE_COMPANY 'Pulse Fitness' becomes 'PULSE FITNESS', but the Import Centre input is limited to 12 characters, and find_orgs_by_ref needs an exact company match.
